prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic fashion editorial portrait of one original approved adult woman in a minimalist white marble kitchen.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with a sleek dark bob, composed sideward gaze and natural skin texture. She wears a structured black blazer over a supplied black structured fashion bodysuit, leaning against a marble kitchen island.
composition_elements: Eye-level 50mm portrait with subject leaning against a structural island, one hand resting on the surface and body turned slightly to the side.
White marble environment contrasted with deep black attire.
Hard diagonal window-blind shadows form geometric shapes across the subject and surfaces; preserve monochrome graphic hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard sunlight through window blinds creating a geometric gobo effect, sharp diagonal shadows, controlled ambient fill and high contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 50mm prime lens at f/8, sharp focus across subject and marble, realistic pores and fabric texture, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
